title: Meet Kai: The paws-itively perfect pooch for your ʻohana! - NewsBreak
text: HONOLULU (KHON2) — Meet Kai, a lovable 2-year-old Pit Bull Terrier mix, KHON2’s featured pet for this week’s Wags ‘n’ Whiskers! Kai was brought to the Moʻiliʻili Hawaiian Humane Society campus back in April, after his previous owner could no longer provide proper care for the pooch. Nevertheless, this bundle of joy is filled with love and affection that will surely steal your heart. He has a big love for adventure, and even went on a field trip to the beach recently, where his adventure buddy commented on Kai’s perfect leash manners. In addition to his love for the beach, Kai loves car rides and showing off his tricks like catching, sitting and more. Get Hawaii’s latest morning news delivered to your inbox, sign up for News 2 You At the end of the day, Kai is the perfect cuddle buddy as he loves to snuggle on laps and enjoy all the affection he can get. Kai’s adoption fee is waived and he comes with a bunch of goodies to help him settle into his new hale, courtesy of the Reid Krucky Memorial Fund. Potential pet parents can meet Kai at the Moʻiliʻili campus seven days a week from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KHON2.
